traits.label: Hymenium
traits.text: Gills are close and white, but may take on a grayish hue as the mushroom ages. Darkening when pressed.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium: Gills are close and white, but may take on a grayish hue as the mushroom ages. Darkening when pressed.

traits.label: Cap
traits.text: 5-12 cm in diameter. Initially convex, maturing to nearly flat, with a slightly inrolled margin. Smooth, and typically gray-brown to brown.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Cap: 5-12 cm in diameter. Initially convex, maturing to nearly flat, with a slightly inrolled margin. Smooth, and typically gray-brown to brown.

traits.label: Hymenium Attachment
traits.text: Adnate to slightly sinuate.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Hymenium Attachment: Adnate to slightly sinuate.

traits.label: Stipe
traits.text: Cylindrical, white, and typically smooth or slightly fibrous, with no ring.
traits.raw: ℹ️ Stipe: Cylindrical, white, and typically smooth or slightly fibrous, with no ring.

traits.label: Spore print
traits.text: Spore Print: White.
traits.raw: ⚪ Spore Print: White.

traits.label: Ecology
traits.text: Saprobic; typically growing in dense clusters on disturbed ground, often near rotting wood or wood chips.
traits.raw: 🪵 Saprobic; typically growing in dense clusters on disturbed ground, often near rotting wood or wood chips.

traits.label: Edibility
traits.text: Edible and said to be mild in flavor, but as always caution is advised.
traits.raw: 😐 Edible and said to be mild in flavor, but as always caution is advised.

traits.label: Fruit body
traits.text: Generally 5-15 cm tall.
traits.raw: 📏 Generally 5-15 cm tall.

traits.label: Microscopy
traits.text: Spores are elliptical, smooth, and hyaline.
traits.raw: 🔬 Spores are elliptical, smooth, and hyaline.

traits.label: Odour
traits.text: Mild or not distinctive.
traits.raw: 👃 Mild or not distinctive.

traits.text: Recognized by its habit of growing in clusters and its fairly large, brownish caps. It's found widely in North America and Europe.
